headline: Ho Chi Minh City accelerates development of TOD urban areas
summary: Ho Chi Minh City is gradually implementing transit-oriented development, with a legal framework and planning roadmap linked to metro lines. The model is expected to open growth room for the real estate market.
why: Transit-oriented development concentrates housing and commercial projects near rail lines, creating opportunities for property developers and construction firms.
